sota_findings.title: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
key_innovations: Monte Carlo dropout RNN for uncertainty quantification
Spatial shot-chart embeddings per team per zone
sota_findings.relevance: SOTA target — Brier 0.199 directly matches our <0.20 goal

sota_findings.title: Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction analysis
sota_findings.model: CNN (lowest in comparative; stacked ensemble uses NB+AdaBoost+MLP+KNN+XGB+DT+LR)
key_innovations: CNN feature extractor + stacked tabular base learners
AdaBoost as meta-learner showed strong calibration
Ensemble diversity via heterogeneous base model selection
sota_findings.relevance: CNN 0.221 < our S18 live best 0.22248 — already below on GPU; CPU tree gap is small

sota_findings.title: Comparing Machine Learning Methods for NBA Game Outcome Prediction

sota_findings.relevance: Validation methodology — benchmark framework applicable to our island eval

proposed_improvements.name: Multi-scale rolling-form windows
proposed_improvements.description: Add 21-game rolling window features alongside existing 3/7/15-game windows. SOTA paper uses multi-scale specifically for playoff momentum. Engine v3.1 partially has this — extend range.
proposed_improvements.implementation: features/engine.py: add rolling_21 window variants to team_form category group

proposed_improvements.name: Shot-zone success rate features
proposed_improvements.description: Per-team paint/midrange/3pt success rates as features. SOTA paper's spatial shot-chart embeddings — CPU-compatible proxy via season averages from data already in full-odds-2025-26.json team_total categories.
proposed_improvements.implementation: Derive from existing team_total categories in betting data; no new data source needed
proposed_improvements.target_island: S15 (catboost, fresh post-reset, good exploration candidate)
